div.div: chunk_id = "<ECLI>#position" — stable across runs, so reindexing is an upsert and not a duplicate. The chunker is a pure function: the same ruling always yields the same chunks, which makes it testable with no model, no database and no network.

div.div: Without this structure an answer could cite "a ruling of the Noord-Nederland district court". With it, the answer cites the paragraph it came from — and that is the difference between something that sounds convincing and something that can be checked.
